gaps.lead: There isn't a single clean cup left in the cupboard.
gaps.hint: run out of = have none left
gaps.explanation: run out of = have no more of something left.

gaps.lead: The soup needed a little more salt.
gaps.explanation: needed a little more = didn't have enough (salt).

gaps.lead: People say the castle is haunted.
gaps.explanation: People say X is… → X is said to be…

gaps.lead: As well as speaking fluent French, she also speaks Russian.
gaps.explanation: in addition to = as well as.

gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.

gaps.lead: The play was so boring that we left early.
gaps.explanation: 'So boring' becomes 'such a boring play that …'.
